name: word cards pair with a generative scope diagram
looks: Each new phrase arrives with its own small generative diagram drawn in the same green line-work: a tangled interference knot for a complex process, a woven double-helix for combined skills, an orbiting ellipse for a finished delivery. A small stage counter and changing section tag sit in the corner, ticking up with each card. The scanline strip keeps breathing underneath throughout.
build: 2D canvas/SVG generative glyph (Lissajous knot, sine-pair weave, orbit ellipse) rendered per-card from a small seeded parametric set, paired with a hard-cut DOM word/phrase; a small mono stage counter ('STEP n/10') cross-fades in the corner on each new card.
sound: A soft blip on each card's cut, a low shimmer under the diagram as it forms.
prompt: Build a short run of hard-cut word cards on a black field, each paired with its own small generative diagram -- a tangled knot, a woven pair of threads, an orbiting shape -- whose form echoes what the word means. Keep every card in the same thin monochrome line style so the instrument feels continuous even as the content changes, and tick a small stage counter in the corner so the viewer senses progress through a process.
